profile.name: DMG-CPU-B
profile.applicability: Original software banking fixture for the deterministic bootless DMG-CPU-B profile; not physical hardware evidence.

protocol.markers: WRAM C000=0xA5 is pass, C001=0xEE is fail; the guest then halts with interrupts disabled.
protocol.result_bytes: C002 bank 0 in the upper window, C003 low-byte/high-bit write orders, C004 RAM banking, C005 bank 0x1FF. Each is 0x01 pass, 0xFF fail, 0x00 not run.
protocol.rumble_expectation: On the committed 0x1E image the guest's only writes to 0x4000-0x5FFF are 0x00..0x07, 0x0F and 0x08. 0x0F reaches RAM bank 7 (bit 3 masked from banking) and turns the line on once; the test expects gbb_rumble_state on=1 with exactly 1 transition.
protocol.variant_1b: The test patches header byte 0x147 to 0x1B in memory (checksum fixed): the same guest reaches RAM bank 15 of 128 KiB and gbb_rumble_state reports GBB_NO_RUMBLE.
protocol.variant_1ff: The test inflates the image in memory to exactly 8 MiB, patches 0x148 to 0x08, stamps the harness-supplied marker 0x5A at 0x1FF * 0x4000 + 0x1000 (and the low byte 0x01..0x03 at banks 0x101..0x103 so the nine-bit write-order checks stay valid), and fixes the header checksum. Bank 0xFF stays zero. The marker is harness-supplied and not part of the committed ROM.

evidence_class: original software fixture plus synthetic oracle, not hardware evidence
scope_limits: No physical DMG-CPU-B or MBC5 hardware observation
No physical rumble motor observation; the rumble line is observed only through gbb_rumble_state
The bank 0x1FF marker is harness-supplied; no committed original ROM exceeds 64 KiB
Not installed and not part of the install allowlist
